title: Phase 1.2H-R1 content-free access receipt
description: The only artifact the in-VNet access job is permitted to emit. It is closed at every level: additionalProperties is false everywhere, so a field that would carry private material cannot be added without changing this committed schema. It carries counts, verdicts, public identifiers and digests of public expected values. It carries no member name, no path below the registered prefix, no object bytes, no excerpt, no credential and no unrestricted traceback.

execution_id.description: An operator-assigned run label, passed to the container at job-definition time. It is deliberately NOT the Azure Container Apps execution name, which does not exist until after the job is started and therefore cannot be baked into the job definition that produces this receipt. The ACA execution name is carried separately in aca_execution_name when the platform exposes it.

aca_execution_name.description: The Azure Container Apps job execution name as observed from the platform environment inside the replica, or null when the platform did not expose it. Public infrastructure identity.

reason_code.description: A closed vocabulary. A free-text reason is deliberately not permitted, because free text is where private material leaks.

probe_source_sha256.description: Digest of the probe's own source as it ran, so the receipt binds to the exact code rather than only to the image.

client_id.description: A user-assigned managed identity client ID. This is a public Azure resource identifier, not a credential.

effective_read_only_verdict.description: READ_ONLY_CONFIRMED requires that this process actually read the role assignments of the credential it used. The probe deliberately holds no permission to do so, because granting it one would increase the very privilege this round minimises. NOT_CONFIRMED_IN_JOB is therefore the honest verdict for an in-job probe: the credential was proven to be the frozen designated identity, and that identity's role assignments are recorded as an operator control-plane observation in the decision record, not as an in-job attestation.

role_condition_sha256.description: Digest of the ABAC condition text if one is applied. The condition text itself is not emitted.

public_network_access.description: Unknown is the only value an in-job probe can honestly emit. publicNetworkAccess is a control-plane property of the storage account; reading it would require a management-plane role the designated identity deliberately does not hold. The control-plane observation is made separately by the operator before the job is started and is recorded in the decision record. Emitting Disabled here would be echoing an argument, not reporting a measurement.

expected_private_ip.description: Echoed from the frozen decision record. It is a private RFC1918 address inside the project VNet and is already committed publicly. The pattern exists so this field cannot be used as a free-text side channel.

resolved_ip_matches_only.description: True when the FULL set of addresses returned by getaddrinfo for the blob FQDN equalled exactly {expected_private_ip}. This is a pre-flight resolution fact recorded by this process. It is not an attestation about the connection the SDK subsequently opened, which resolves the FQDN independently. The narrower claim is the one that can be supported.

prefix_scope.description: Asserts that enumeration was confined to the registered prefix. The prefix string itself is public and lives in the decision record; it is not repeated here.

decode_attempts.description: Structurally pinned to zero. A receipt reporting any decode attempt is schema-invalid, so the probe cannot report one and pass.

observed_aggregate_digest.description: SHA-256 over the sorted observed per-object digests. When access succeeds this equals the public digest_set_digest, so it discloses nothing new; when it differs it discloses only that fact.

items.description: Closed-vocabulary invariant identifiers only, never a message.
